klipler.istem: The snail glides slowly forward on the leaf, its eye-stalks gently sway and stretch, a water droplet rolls off the leaf. Static camera. Same snail, same shell, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
The toothed ribbon slowly undulates like a wave, light glints across the rows of tiny teeth. Slow camera glide. 3D science animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
The snail's mouth slowly scrapes along the leaf edge, the scraped area grows a little, tiny leaf particles drift. Static camera. Same snail, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.

The toothed ribbon moves slowly forward like a conveyor belt, fresh sharp teeth slide toward the front where the worn teeth are. Static camera. 3D science animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
